name: First Mexican Empire (1821–1823)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of green, white and red with a crowned brown eagle standing on a cactus in the centre of the white stripe.
history: The first national flag of Mexico, decreed by Agustín de Iturbide in November 1821 after independence and first used officially in July 1822: the green, white and red of the Army of the Three Guarantees with the crowned eagle of the empire. After the fall of Iturbide the republic replaced the crowned eagle in 1823.
